Title: [SPIKE-001] Evaluate Places providers
Description: Compare providers on coverage in launch areas (incl. street food), price/hours/cuisine fields, caching and display licence terms, cost per request and per Kampai group. Desk research done (docs/SPIKE-001_PLACES_PROVIDER.md); real-data test pending launch area and API keys. Blocks PLAT-003.

Title: [SPIKE-002] PDPA review incl. intent data and pseudonymous tracking
Description: PDPA review: Thai privacy notice (s.23), lawful basis (s.19/24), retention (Q-002), minors (Q-003), cross-border (Q-004). Extended: aggregated intent data and counting unique users without accounts (Q-018, F-09). Needs external legal review. Blocks PRIV-001 and INT-001.

Title: [PLAT-001] Web app shell (Next.js, mobile-first, PWA)
Description: Requirement PLAT-001 (D-013). Mobile-first web app, centered column on desktop, bottom navigation (Kampai, Eat, Me). AC in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md. Starts after Gate 2.

Title: [PLAT-002] Supabase schema, anonymous sign-in, Apple/Google auth, RLS
Description: Requirement PLAT-002. Tables incl. groups, group_members, group_votes, intent_records (no client access). Anonymous sign-in for everyone not logged in (D-017); Apple/Google providers. CI fails on any table without RLS policy.

Title: [ANL-001] Event instrumentation and dashboard
Description: Requirement ANL-001. Events and KPI formulas in docs/ANALYTICS_PLAN.md. No coordinates, names or free text in events.

Title: [ANL-002] Strategy metrics: K-factor, organizer repeat, saturation
Description: Requirement ANL-002 (D-020). K = I x A x H with confidence interval, network saturation, organizer repeat (login vs not), completion within 5 min. Unique persons by member_pseudo_id; document cross-device limitation (A-010).

Title: [PLAT-003] Places adapter with rate limit, daily cap, kill switch
Description: Requirement PLAT-003. Provider behind searchPlaces(criteria). Rate limit per anonymous user and IP, daily cap, kill switch, one search per group (R-014). Cache only as licence allows.

Title: [PRIV-001] Location pre-prompt, privacy notice, consent log, delete data
Description: Requirement PRIV-001. Pre-prompt for location, privacy notice, consent log, delete account/data, participant can delete own group participation. Analytics banner must not block voting.

Title: [GRP-003] Participants join Kampai without login
Description: Requirement GRP-003 (D-017). Participant joins via link with no login or tab bar; anonymous session; optional nickname; works inside LINE in-app browser; vote within 3 taps (H-009).

Title: [GRP-002] Kampai on web: create, share, vote, decide
Description: Requirement GRP-002 (D-016). Create group (budget cap, area, deadline), share link, preferences, 3-5 place shortlist, voting, close. Tie: organizer chooses (D-003); remind organizer, no choice within 5 min closes the group with no result and the organizer can restart voting (D-023). Non-voters abstain (D-004). Min 2 voices (A-004). Link expires 24h, max 20 members (A-008).

Title: [GRP-004] Shareable result card
Description: Requirement GRP-004. Result card: place, area, price, time, map link, share (Web Share/copy), link preview without member names, CTA 'create your own' with source_group_id.

Title: [GRP-005] Voting deadline and close rules
Description: Requirement GRP-005. Default 5-minute close (2-15 adjustable), countdown, no auto-close below 2 voices, extend without resetting TTY clock. Values are proposals.

Title: [SOLO-002] Shortlist of up to 3 places with reasons
Description: Requirement SOLO-002. Shared recommendation engine. Up to 3 places with reasons; states: 3, 1-2, none, slow, error. No repeats on reroll.

Title: [SOLO-004] Open external map navigation
Description: Requirement SOLO-004. Universal https Google Maps link with copyable address fallback. Shared with Kampai result card.

Title: [SOLO-001] Solo home: budget, cuisine, radius, location
Description: Requirement SOLO-001 (Should, D-016). Budget is a cap (D-002). Denied-location path with area picker. Emits criteria_completed (D-001). No login needed.

Title: [SOLO-003] Idempotent decision confirmation and Time to Yes
Description: Requirement SOLO-003 (Should). TTY = decision_confirmed - first criteria_completed in session (D-001, A-001). Works for anonymous users. Idempotent by decision_id.

Title: [SOLO-005] Feedback, preferences and Me tab
Description: Requirement SOLO-005. Thumbs up boosts ranking, thumbs down hides place; Me tab.

Title: [AUTH-001] Sign in with Apple / Google after a decision, account linking
Description: Requirement AUTH-001 (D-017, D-012, D-014). Login offered after a successful decision, skippable, not shown again for 7 days; participants never prompted. Link anonymous data to the account (verify Supabase linkIdentity). Apple + Google, link both, at least one remains, in-app delete, LINE in-app browser handling. Includes Apple Developer and Google Cloud credential setup.

Title: [INT-001] Aggregated group intent record
Description: Requirement INT-001 (D-018). Aggregated, non-identifying intent record per confirmed group (budget tier, area, hour, headcount bucket, cuisine vote totals, chosen place). No member ids, no client access, no export, no offers in MVP1.

Title: [BRAND-001] PWA icons and logo (existing palette)
Description: Requirement BRAND-001 (D-019 revised). Keep the existing palette; no token change. PWA icons incl. maskable and theme color Cream/Coral. Logo choice (K+Fork vs current) pending Q-019; trademark check Q-016. Concept preview images are not production assets.

Title: [GRP-001] Kampai clickable prototype (delivered)
Description: Requirement GRP-001. Delivered as prototype/index.html (updated for D-016..D-023). Reference for GRP-002.

Title: [REL-001] Web beta release preparation
Description: Requirement REL-001 (D-013). Production domain, hosting, privacy policy page, delete-account page, analytics consent banner, tested on iOS Safari, Chrome Android and LINE in-app browser. No store submission.

Title: [OPS-001] Founder runbook
Description: Requirement OPS-001. One page. PDPA s.37(4) 72-hour notification steps, kill switch, cost alerts.

Title: [UXR-001] Real-user test plan
Description: Requirement UXR-001 (D-022). Start from 2-3 non-overlapping networks; define sample size, script, and pass criteria for H-007..H-009 and H-001. Report K with confidence interval and saturation; note small non-representative sample.

Title: [WPL-001] Workplace pilot kit
Description: Requirement WPL-001 (Could). Starts only after the organizer-repeat gate (D-020). Recurring group, preset per-head budget, CSV export without names. No ERP integration or per-customer customization.
